categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Injoinic Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and sales of high-performance, high-quality mixed-signal integrated circuits, primarily in power management chips and fast charging protocol chips. Their products serve diverse fields including consumer electronics, smart wearables, photovoltaic new energy, lithium battery energy storage, IoT, communication equipment, and automotive electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs proprietary mixed-signal SoC integration technology, fast charging interface protocol integration, low-power multi-power management, high-precision ADC and coulomb counting, high-power boost/buck technology, and micro sound playback system technology. It operates under a fabless model, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and service providers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading consumer electronics brands such as Xiaomi, OPPO, Vivo, Samsung, and Honor. The company targets markets in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, AI servers, 5G communications, smart home, IoT, and new energy sectors, with products integrated into mobile phones, TWS earphones, photovoltaic inverters, energy storage systems, and automotive-grade applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters in Shenzhen and offices in Zhuhai, Shanghai, Suzhou, Chengdu, and other cities. It also has subsidiaries in Singapore and the United States, indicating a growing international presence. Domestic sales dominate revenue, but overseas sales have shown significant growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Injoinic operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless chip design company. It designs and sells integrated circuits while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries and service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in power management and fast charging technologies, expanding into automotive electronics, AI power management, new energy, smart audio processing, and smart home sectors. It emphasizes strengthening R&D capabilities, talent acquisition, and industry integration through strategic investments and mergers to maintain technological leadership and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuits, including power management chips and fast charging protocol chips. The company sells via a mixed model of distribution (majority) and direct sales to end customers, including OEMs and brand manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Injoinic is positioned as one of the leading domestic suppliers of power management and fast charging chips in China, competing with both domestic and international semiconductor companies. It holds competitive advantages in technology integration, product reliability, and broad protocol compatibility, securing partnerships with major global smartphone brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.43 billion, a 17.66% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 124 million, a 323% increase. The company has shown strong growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding product lines and market penetration. Total assets reached RMB 2.13 billion with steady growth in net assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Injoinic emphasizes high integration, cost-performance balance, and customizable power management SoC chips that shorten customer development cycles and improve product reliability. Its fast charging chips offer high compatibility with multiple protocols and superior reliability, maintaining low failure rates. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities and proximity to key customers in the Pearl River Delta to rapidly respond to market needs and deliver innovative, high-quality chip solutions.
